name: Macro VIX calm risk-on — long crypto only when equity fear is low
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from dvol-calm-regime-momentum, which gates on CRYPTO-NATIVE implied vol): the equity VIX is the cross-asset price of fear; crypto's beta to broad risk assets means that when equity-implied vol is LOW the macro liquidity tide is risk-on and crypto's drawdown tail is compressed, so a long earns its risk premium without the regime-crash overhang. This conditions a crypto long on an EXTERNAL macro state (US equity options), not on crypto's own vol — an orthogonal regime read. Entry: VIX below a fitted calm ceiling AND price in a non-broken uptrend (trend floor). Exit: VIX crosses UP through a stress threshold (the regime flips risk-off — get flat) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if the same trend long UNCONDITIONALLY (drop the VIX gate) matches the deflated Sharpe, VIX adds nothing — the edge must be the regime conditioning. Disconfirmer 2: VIX and crypto-native dvol are correlated; if substituting dvol does as well, this is dvol-calm re-skinned and adds no orthogonal MACRO information. Disconfirmer 3 (cost): net of ~20bps Binance spot round-trip the conditional long must beat buy-and-hold's deflated Sharpe. tier0 macro feature, low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: equity VIX in a calm (low-fear) regime — macro risk-on tide for a crypto long
